title: Paired maternal milk + matched placental ECM as a donor-linked bacterial-cellulose materials gate

why_paired_design_is_cleaner.logic: Milk from a specific mother and placental material from the same pregnancy share one pregnancy-specific endocrine, immune, metabolic and fetal-sex context. Pairing therefore removes one major source of between-donor mismatch when asking whether placental state and subsequent milk composition jointly associate with a BC/material phenotype.
why_paired_design_is_cleaner.important_limit: Pairing reduces donor confounding but does not remove lactation-stage, diet, maternal health, delivery, collection, storage, placental-region, processing, microbial and oxygen confounds.

why_not_raw_placenta: raw tissue adds blood, viable and dying cells, nucleic acids, proteases and variable bioburden
raw tissue makes it difficult to assign any observed material effect to ECM rather than degradation or contamination
decellularization converts the question into a cleaner materials-science test of collagen/fibronectin/laminin/GAG-rich scaffold versus BC

non_operational_comparison_matrix.description: BC reference with no human-derived material
paired donor milk branch without placental ECM
matched placental dECM branch without donor milk
milk plus dECM from the same pregnancy
milk and placental dECM from different donors, where ethically and scientifically justified
non_operational_comparison_matrix.purpose: test whether same-pregnancy pairing matters beyond composition alone

fetal_sex_covariate.model: XX_or_XY_fetal_state -> sex-specific placental regulation -> maternal physiological response -> possible component-specific milk differences
fetal_sex_covariate.rule: Do not call a result XY-specific unless the effect replicates across independent donors and is linked to measured composition rather than sex label alone.

safety_boundary.human_materials: Any real donor human milk or placental material work requires appropriate institutional consent, ethics, biosafety, handling, storage and disposal procedures.
safety_boundary.raw_placenta: No uncontrolled raw-placenta mixed-culture protocol is provided or endorsed.
safety_boundary.consumption: No experimentally inoculated or fermented human milk is for consumption or infant feeding.
safety_boundary.scope: This record is a non-operational materials-science design and evidence gate, not a medical or food protocol.
